dedupe_keys.name: network traffic analysis under emerging beyond 5g scenarios for multi band optical technology adoption

description: Ruiz, Marc and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. Registered publication metadata describe a traffic-analysis method combining established mass-market services with anticipated B5G services. It estimates traffic that operators must support in metro-aggregation, metro-core and backbone segments. Coverage uses inputs and forecasts from major European operators to examine network needs through the end of the decade. Numerical results concern scenario-based demand and multiband adoption; they are not measured future traffic. Exact operator input tables and service-uptake assumptions are unavailable in the abstract. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
